warnings: axfL (with wfL, gfL) can slide 16.0 mm (-axis -y) until wfL touches wfR; after 9.4 mm it comes out of the motor motf's output (the drive is lost). Only the friction of the cross fit holds it there. Add a bush or stop so it cannot travel that far.

gfL (on axfL) can slide 16.0 mm (-axis -y) until wfL touches wfR; after 7.0 mm it is out of mesh with igaL and the drive stops. Only the friction of the cross fit holds it. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.

igaL (on iaaL) can slide 8.0 mm (-axis -y) until ibuaL38 touches wfL; after 7.0 mm it is out of mesh with gfL and the drive stops. Nothing holds it there; straight teeth do not push it, but side loads on the wheels can walk it along the axle. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.
